keywords.indexterm: windshield defrosting and defogging auto defogging system

conbody.p: Auto defogging reduces the possibility of fogging up the inside of the windshield by automatically sensing the moisture of inside the windshield.
Auto Defog System is activated when you select SettingsVehicleClimateDefog/Defrost OptionsAuto Defog from the Settings in the infotainment system screen.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.

section.title: To cancel or reset the Auto Defogging System
section.p: Touch the front windshield defroster icon for 3 seconds when the EV button is in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position.
When the ADS system is canceled, indicator on the icon will blink 3 times per 0.5 sec and the ADS OFF position will be displayed on the climate control information screen.
When the ADS system is reset, indicator on the icon will blink 6 times per 0.25 sec and the position ADS OFF position will be disappeared on the climate control information screen.
You can set or release the Auto Defogging System on the Climate Information selection screen.
Auto Defog System is activated when you select SettingsVehicleClimateDefog/Defrost OptionsAuto Defog from the Settings in the infotainment system screen.
If the battery is discharged or detached, the auto defogging system will be reset. Adjust the feature accordingly.

li.p: Touching one of air intake control icon, A/C icon, wind direction mode selection icons will deactivate the Auto Defogging System. To secure a driver’s vision, never touch air intake control icon, A/C icon, wind direction mode selection icons while the Auto Defogging System is running.
Do not remove the sensor cover located on the upper end of the windshield glass. Removing the cover can damage the sensor.
